title: Newly Established Resort Equity Stake For Sale in Colombo, Sri Lanka
tagline: We’re launching an exciting resort hotel project just south of Colombo, Sri Lanka, which is currently in the planning stage and pre-revenue. - Already secured a prime 26-acre piece of land next to the largest water body in the country, boasting approximately 600 meters of waterfront, with the land ownership documents in place. - The location offers access to the Indian Ocean by boat, with the river approximately 180 meters wide, providing a unique waterfront setting. - It’s approximately an hour’s drive from the airport via the highway, offering convenient access for tourists. - We’ve already obtained the primary building approvals, with final approval pending completion of the project design. - The project will be developed in phases over 5 years, with the first phase expected to be completed in 3 years. - We aim to start selling units in approximately 18 months under a sale-and-lease-back model. - Projecting gross revenue of around USD 43 million, with an EBITDA margin of approximately 39%.
